name: Clear Lava — See Through Lava
summary: Makes lava semi-transparent so you can see what is underneath before you take the plunge.
body:
Vanilla lava is a solid orange wall — you never know what is below. This pack makes it **see-through**.

- 🌋 **Translucent lava** — see terrain and mobs under the surface
- 🧭 **Safer nether travel** — spot drops before crossing
- ✅ **Works on every launcher** — just drop in `resourcepacks` and enable

---

### 🚀 Want everything in one pack?
This feature is part of **[PvP Essentials](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/pvp-essentials-crosshair-visible-ores-sword-low)** — the all-in-one pack with crosshair, visible ores, short sword, low fire and clear pumpkin.
> 💡 **CurseForge is the source of truth** — the most up-to-date, bug-free versions land there first: [CurseForge page](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/clear-lava-see-through-lava)
